title: Interview With V.A. Ornatsky, Suspected Of Being Responsible For Dinner Party Hoax At The Majestic Cafe

Form No. 31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. 5516 / S. B. REGISTRY. / SEC. No. D2 / Date January 3, 1934）

Subject (in full) Interview with V.A.Ornatsky,suspected of being responsible
for dinner party hoax at the Majestic Cafe.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by O.J. Smeral

With reference to the endorsement of the Officer
i/c Special Branch on the attached report dated December 16,1933,
on the subject of an unknown Russian responsible for the dinner
party hoax at the Majestic Cafe on December 3,1933, the under-
signed visited V.A. Ornatsky,who is strongly suspected of being
the culprit, at No 19 Route Dollfus,his present address, and
warned him accordingly.

He denies having anything to do with the affair.

A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Jule
MS
JAN 3 1934

事由（全称） 约谈 V.A. Ornatsky，其涉嫌对马杰斯蒂克咖啡馆（Majestic Cafe）晚宴恶作剧事件负责。

呈报人：副督察普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev） 转呈人：O.J. Smeral

鉴于附件中 dated 1933年12月16日的报告上特务科主管警官的批注，该报告涉及一名身份不明的俄国人，其涉嫌于1933年12月3日在马杰斯蒂克咖啡馆策划晚宴恶作剧，签署人前往多尔富斯路（Route Dollfus）19号——即 V.A. Ornatsky 目前的住址——拜访了这位被强烈怀疑为肇事者的嫌疑人，并 accordingly 对其进行了警告。

他否认与此事有任何关联。

A. Prokofiev
副督察

特务科主管警官。

Jule
MS
1934年1月3日

S.2, Special Branch.
Date December 16, 1933.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5516
Date 16/12/33

Subject (in full) Enquiry res. unknown Russian responsible for dinner party hoax at the Majestic Cafe.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature] - S.D.

With reference to the attached report of the Chief Inspector i/c Sinza Police Station dated December 5, 1933, on the subject of a Russian, name unknown, who on December 3 visited the Majestic Cafe, Bubbling Well Road, and falsely pretending that he was acting on instructions of Mr. Bogomoloff, Soviet Ambassador, made arrangements for an expensive dinner party, which subsequently nobody attended, enquiries show that a Russian named V.A. Ornatsky is strongly suspected of being the culprit. The following is an outline of enquiries which led to the suspicion against the above named individual :-

On December 5 the undersigned visited the Majestic Cafe and interviewed Mr. Schiller, manager of the cafe, and five Chinese members of his staff. They described the unknown Russian as being 22-24 years of age, about 5'10" tall, medium build, brown eyes, brown straight hair brushed back; wearing dark blue double-breast jacket with brass buttons and some brass badges on the collar, dark overcoat and grey felt hat. According to Mr. Schiller the badges on the collar were similar to those of the Harbin Polytechnic School uniform. The Russian seemed to have a fairly good knowledge of English.

On December 8 Mr. Schiller was taken to a certain place where he was shown a number of photographs with the result that he identified V.A. Ornatsky as being the culprit. On the following day twelve photographs, including two different photographs of Ornatsky, were shown to each of the five Chinese employees of the Majestic Cafe referred to above. Of these one named Loh Ah Zien (陸阿錢) immediately identified Ornatsky, while Zung Ying Keng (陳應根) and Dong Tsung Yoen (唐震元) picked out the two photographs of Ornatsky and stated that the culprit

事由（全称） 关于对马杰斯蒂克咖啡馆晚宴恶作剧事件负责的未知俄国人的调查。
呈报人：副督察普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev） 转呈人：[签名] - S.D.

鉴于静安寺捕房（Sinza Police Station）主管总巡官于1933年12月5日提交的附件报告，该报告涉及一名姓名不详的俄国人，此人于12月3日前往静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）的马杰斯蒂克咖啡馆，谎称奉苏联大使博戈莫洛夫先生（Mr. Bogomoloff）之指示，安排了一场昂贵的晚宴，结果无人出席。调查显示，一名名为 V.A. Ornatsky 的俄国人被强烈怀疑为肇事者。以下是导致对上述个人产生怀疑的调查概要：

12月5日，签署人走访了马杰斯蒂克咖啡馆，会见了该店经理席勒先生（Mr. Schiller）及其五名中国职员。他们描述这名未知的俄国人年龄约22至24岁，身高约5英尺10英寸，中等身材，棕色眼睛，棕色直发向后梳理；身穿带有铜纽扣和领口佩戴若干铜徽章的深蓝色双排扣夹克，外罩深色大衣，头戴灰色毡帽。据席勒先生称，领口的徽章类似于哈尔滨工业大学制服上的徽章。这名俄国人似乎具备相当不错的英语知识。

12月8日，席勒先生被带至某处，向他展示了一些照片，结果他指认 V.A. Ornatsky 为肇事者。次日，向上述马杰斯蒂克咖啡馆的五名中国职员每人展示了十二张照片，其中包括 Ornatsky 的两张不同照片。其中一名叫陆阿钱（Loh Ah Zien）的职员立即指认出 Ornatsky，而陈应根（Zung Ying Keng）和唐震元（Dong Tsung Yoen）则挑出了 Ornatsky 的两张照片，并表示肇事者

主管科长
见无
QC (特务科)
最好就此类玩笑警告 Ornatsky。

（左下角印章）：
副总监
KMS
(刑事科)

was very much like the individuals appearing on these photographs.
    Ornatsky's address being located at House 52, No. 1295
Rue Lafayette, it was arranged on December 14 that Mr. Schiller
had a chance of seeing him in person, being unobserved by the
latter.    Mr. Schiller stated that he had little doubt that
Ornatsky was the man who had fooled him.    It was then agreed
that before this report is submitted, Mr. Schiller should point
out the suspect to the Chinese members of his staff and see if
they too could identify him.    This could be easily done as
Ornatsky is employed in a public place.    However, later on the
same date Mr. Schiller informed the undersigned by phone that he
had decided to drop the case, as the actual damage caused is only
$80.00 and the prosecution of the culprit would mean a considerable
loss of his and his employees' time.    He also was afraid that
the whole affair would "make him look like a fool."
    A glance on the attached list of guests whom Mr. Schiller
expected in vain after he had put himself to a considerable
trouble in order to secure various Russian delicacies ordered
by the would-be Air-Pilot, is sufficient to understand why
Mr. Schiller is not very keen on making the affair public.
He had a dim suspicion that he had been a victim of a conspiracy
to get him out of his position.
    The motive of similar tricks, reference to which is made
in article published in the "Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury" of
December 14, 1933 (cutting attached) seems to be of a different
nature, as persons likely to be annoyed by these tricks include
Soviet consular officials.    So far no information is available
as to the identity of the person who visited Messrs Hoggard &
Sigler, Sassoon House.    Enquiries show that he is not identical

    Ornatsky 的住址已查明为霞飞路（Rue Lafayette）1295号52室，遂于12月14日安排席勒先生有机会在不被对方察觉的情况下亲眼见到他。席勒先生表示，他几乎可以肯定 Ornatsky 就是愚弄他的人。随后商定，在提交本报告之前，席勒先生应向其中方职员指出该嫌疑人，看看他们是否也能指认他。由于 Ornatsky 受雇于公共场所，这很容易做到。然而，同日稍后，席勒先生通过电话告知签署人，他决定放弃此案，因为实际损失仅为80.00美元，而起诉肇事者将意味着他和他的员工要耗费大量时间。他还担心整件事会让他“看起来像个傻瓜”。

Dec 5 1933

Ordering Food by False Pretences that Same
Soviet Ambassador.

xx and SPECIAL INQUIRY C.I. Stubbings.

Sir,

I beg to forward a copy of report made in the
Occurrence Book dated 4/12/33.

"At 12.15p.m. 4/12/33 Mr. Schiller, Manager of the
Majestic Cafe, Bubbling Well Road, came to the Station and
reported that at about 6.30p.m. 3/12/33, an unknown Russian
in Soviet Uniform, who claimed to be an Air Pilot, went to the
above Cafe and stated he wanted to arrange a Dinner party for
14 prominent guests, mentioning Major Wu and several Consul
Officials as being among the guests who were to be entertained
by Mr. B. Bogomoloff, the Soviet Ambassador whom he was alleged
to be fixing the Dinner arrangements for. He requested that the
food be the very best of Russian Food obtainable and that it
would be advisable to have extra guards on the doors in case
of any anti Soviet interference. The Dinner was all prepared
for 10.30p.m. but the party failed to appear, this putting the
management of the Cafe to a lot of unnecessary expenses and
labour. Mr. Schiller made enquiries at the Soviet Consul on
4/12/33 and was informed that they knew of no Dinner party
being arranged. Description of the Russian ordering the party
as follows: height 5 feet 10 inches, clean shoven, long face
and could speak very good English.

S2/ For inquiry with a view
to establishing the identity
of the culprit and report
please.
A.C. (Special Branch)
DEC. 5 1933

I am, Sir,
Your obedient Servant,

Le Journal de Shanghai.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTER.
No. ID 5516
December 1933.
Date 12 / 12 / 33

WAS IT A PRACTICAL JOKER OR SOME INSANE PERSON?

Several shops on Nanking Road and the Soviet
Consulate-General were made the victims of a practical joker
or of some insane person the other day.
It appears that a man described as tall, dark and
fashionably dressed called at a number of shops on Nanking
Road and placed large orders in the name of the Soviet
Consulate-General, the orders ranging from furniture to
a dinner for 18 persons. When the goods were delivered at
the Consulate-General, they were repudiated.
But the most unpleasant part of the affair was the
arrival at the Soviet Consulate-General of eight persons in
evening dress on Saturday to attend a dinner to which they
had received invitations.
It is said that while waiting in the shops on Nanking
Road, the man carried out an active propaganda for the
soviet regime in the English language.
The man did not appear to have secured any advance of
money from any person nor has anything been reported missing
at the places which he had visited.

日期 1933年12月12日

是恶作剧者还是疯子？

日前，南京路上的几家商店和苏联总领事馆成为了一名恶作剧者或某个疯子的受害者。
据悉，一名被描述为高大、肤色黝黑且衣着时髦的男子走访了南京路上的多家商店，以苏联总领事馆的名义下了大量订单，订单内容从家具到18人的晚宴不等。当货物送至总领事馆时，均被拒收。
但此事最令人不快的部分是，周六有八人身着晚礼服抵达苏联总领事馆，参加他们收到邀请信的晚宴。
据说，该男子在南京路的商店等待期间，用英语积极宣传苏维埃政权。
该男子似乎未从任何人那里骗取预付款，在他访问的地方也没有报告任何物品丢失。

〔此处转录不清：手写签名及批注〕

Several shops on Nanking Road and the Soviet 
Consulate-General were made the victims of a practical joker 
or of some insane person the other daye 

It appears that a man described as tall, dark and 
fashionably a@ressed called at a number of shops on Nanking 
Road and placed large orders in the name of the Soviet 
Consulate-General, the orders ranging from furniture to 
a dinner for I8 persons. When the goods were delivered at 
the Consulate-General, they were repudiated. 

But the most unpleasant part of the affair wag fhe 
arrival at the Soviet Consulate-General of eight persons in 
evening dress on Saturday to attend a dinner to which they 
had received invitations. , 


It is said that while waiting in the shops on Wanking 


Road, the man carried out an active propaganda for the 


soviet regime in the English language. 
The man did not appear to have secured any advance of 


money from any person nor has anything been reported missing 
at the places which he had visited.
